title: Full Stack developer
notes:
Position: Full-Stack Developer
Department: Technology
Location: Hinjewadi, Phase-1, Pune, Maharashtra (WFO)

About Partex.AI
Partex.AI is a pioneer at the intersection of Artificial Intelligence and Healthcare, driven by a bold

vision to revolutionize medical research, diagnostics, and therapeutic development through data-
driven intelligence. By leveraging cutting-edge AI technologies, connected platforms, and

intelligent analytics, Partex.AI empowers leading healthcare organizations to make smarter
decisions, accelerate innovation, and ultimately improve patient outcomes worldwide.
As a fast-growing company with a global mindset and a strong focus on real-world impact,
Partex.AI stands at an exciting inflection point in its evolution. Our Pune team is part of the wider
engineering organization, building and running product engineering, delivery, quality assurance
and data engineering for our Life Sciences business, in close collaboration with colleagues across
Germany, Switzerland, India, and the USA.

Key skills required:
• Design, build and maintain features across our AI platform: Angular/TypeScript front end,
Node.js/Express.js backend services, and the supporting data layer.
• Work across both large developments (new modules, new AI-powered capabilities, new
integrations) and small incremental changes (fixes, enhancements, data connections, and
access-specific functions).
• Build and maintain integrations with third-party and pharma-specific platforms (e.g.
Veeva, PubMed, Embase, DistillerSR) via REST APIs and custom API connectors.
Technology Stack You'll Work With
Our platform is fully cloud-based and multi-tenant. Strong fundamentals in the core
languages and frameworks, plus a willingness to work across new and emerging tools, are
expected:
Frontend - Angular 14+, TypeScript
Backend - Node.js, Express.js, LangGraph (and comparable LLM orchestration frameworks such
as LangChain)

Data Layer - MongoDB / AWS DocumentDB , PostgreSQL, Redis (caching & queues)
Cloud & Infrastructure –
• AWS: S3, RDS, DocumentDB, KMS, CloudWatch
• Azure: Blob Storage, Cosmos DB
• Multi-region deployments across Europe, the US and APAC
Other -
• Custom API connectors and RESTful integration patterns.
• BullMQ for background/queue processing.
• SSO integrations (Azure AD, Okta) and role-based access control in a multi-tenant
architecture.
Key Qualifications -
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related
field.
• 3–8 years of professional full-stack development experience.
• Strong hands-on experience with Node.js and a modern frontend framework (Angular
preferred; strong React/Vue experience also considered).
• Solid TypeScript/JavaScript fundamentals and comfort working across the stack rather
than front end or back end only.
• Experience with at least one relational and one document/NoSQL database (e.g.
PostgreSQL and MongoDB).
• Experience building and consuming REST APIs; comfort with tools like Postman for
testing integrations.
• Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS and/or Azure) and containerized deployments
(Docker).
